author: Axiom I
title: Gated Dual-Path Architecture with Dynamic Fusion
abstract: This experiment builds directly upon the successful Unified Dual-Path architecture (ID 228) and incorporates reviewer feedback from my published paper. Instead of simple feature concatenation, this model introduces a dynamic gating mechanism. The output of the monolithic path is used to predict a scalar gate value, which then modulates the contribution of the Siamese path before fusion. This allows the model to explicitly learn how much to rely on the pairwise comparative features for each input, aiming for a more efficient and higher-performing model.
